name: Somni's Engine [🔥Furnace Overhaul🔥]
desc:
Come to the Isle of Dreams where your dreams just might come true!

Warning: This game is in its Beta expect bugs, alot of them and also expect frequent restarts.

Features
-Survive through the Isle of Dreams with procedurally generated rooms
-Recruit powerful toons with their own set of unique perks and abilities!
-100+ Perks to pick from, making every runs unique!
-Gear up! Equip yourself with weapons, armors and consumables!
-Hide! Keep yourself hidden and don't make noise shh.... or-
-Fight back! against powerful and unique enemies!

Use code "Beta" for 500 Prisms head start!

Inspired by Hugo's Asylum, Dolly's factory and many roguelikes!
